versions.body:
truthseeker_88 (OP): Mara Quinn died July 2. I was at the funeral. Her account came BACK in October and now it LOVES the Waterfront. Dead people don't change their minds.

FACTS:
1. The van that hit her was KESTREL. Kestrel trucks are on every Northgate site. Look it up. [photo: Kestrel van, circled]
2. Every post from her account is at :00 or :30. Every single one. Same with @junopark, @eastfield_dad_mike, @harborwalkerpat. Real people don't post like a train schedule.
3. The brother had the password. Just saying.
4. The Daily Record printed her 'change of heart' and then quietly DELETED it. Who pays the Record? Northgate ads on every page.

112 replies

harbor_hank: owen you said the same about the ferry schedule
truthseeker_88: and was I wrong about the ferry schedule??
millgirl_77: the timestamps thing is actually weird though
truthseeker_88: ALSO they always mirror the photos. Check the text on signs. Use flip & search. I've been saying this for MONTHS.
quietreader: has anyone asked the brother directly?

theo_q: I'm her brother. She was hit by a van. The driver sat on the curb and cried. Stop using my sister's death for clicks.
truthseeker_88: Then who is posting, Theo?
theo_q: I don't know. I reported it. Connect sent a form letter. Maybe it's you. You're the one obsessed.
truthseeker_88: I can barely work my phone, son.
theo_q: then stop messaging me at 3am.
